questions.text: Driving Skills & Safety Training: Competent drivers: (1) Defensive driving training; (2) First aid training; (3) Customer service training; (4) Route knowledge assessment; (5) Vehicle maintenance basics; (6) Emergency response training; (7) Refresher training frequency.
questions.evidence_required: Training curriculum, Attendance logs, Skill assessment results
questions.africa_specific_notes: Many drivers have minimal training. Defensive driving critical (chaotic traffic). First aid can save lives (slow ambulances).

questions.text: Digital Literacy & App Proficiency: Using the platform: (1) App navigation training; (2) GPS usage training; (3) Payment system training (cash, mobile money, card); (4) Troubleshooting common issues; (5) Offline mode usage; (6) Rating system understanding; (7) Support for low-literacy drivers.
questions.evidence_required: Onboarding materials, Training videos, Support ticket analysis
questions.africa_specific_notes: Many drivers are first-time smartphone users. Visual/video training works best. Support in local languages essential.

questions.text: Driver Professionalism & Conduct: Quality service: (1) Dress code/appearance standards; (2) Communication skills (polite, helpful); (3) Handling of complaints; (4) Respect for passenger preferences (music, AC, route); (5) Punctuality; (6) Vehicle cleanliness; (7) Prohibition of harassment.
questions.evidence_required: Code of conduct, Passenger feedback, Quality audits
questions.africa_specific_notes: Professionalism varies widely. Passengers value cleanliness and respect. Harassment (especially of women) is a major issue.

questions.text: Merchant & Delivery Partner Support: Supporting the ecosystem: (1) Merchant onboarding training; (2) Packaging best practices; (3) Order management training; (4) Dispute resolution support; (5) Performance analytics access; (6) Feedback loops; (7) Account management for large merchants.
questions.evidence_required: Merchant training materials, Support logs, Performance dashboards
questions.africa_specific_notes: Small merchants (kiosks, restaurants) often lack digital skills. Hand-holding needed for onboarding.

questions.text: Local Route Knowledge: Knowing the terrain: (1) Knowledge of shortcuts; (2) Awareness of road conditions (potholes, floods); (3) Knowledge of traffic patterns; (4) Awareness of unsafe areas; (5) Alternative routes during events; (6) Landmark-based navigation (poor addressing); (7) Rural area navigation.
questions.evidence_required: Driver assessments, Passenger feedback on route efficiency
questions.africa_specific_notes: GPS often wrong. Local knowledge is critical. Drivers must know which areas are unsafe at night.

questions.text: Technology-Assisted Navigation: Using tools: (1) GPS app proficiency; (2) Traffic app usage (Google Maps, Waze); (3) Offline map usage; (4) ETA accuracy improvement; (5) Multi-stop route optimization (delivery); (6) Fuel-efficient routing; (7) Handling of GPS errors.
questions.evidence_required: Navigation tool usage stats, ETA accuracy metrics
questions.africa_specific_notes: Data costs are a barrier to real-time navigation. Offline maps essential. GPS drift common in dense urban areas.

questions.text: Customer Support Quality: Helping users: (1) Multi-channel support (phone, chat, email); (2) Local language support; (3) Response time (first response, resolution); (4) Escalation protocols; (5) Support agent training; (6) Self-service resources (FAQs); (7) Accessibility (hours of operation).
questions.evidence_required: Support metrics (response time, resolution rate), Training logs, User satisfaction scores
questions.africa_specific_notes: Phone support preferred (low digital literacy). Local language critical. 24/7 support needed for safety issues.

questions.text: Driver Support & Welfare Services: Supporting drivers: (1) Driver support hotline; (2) In-person support centers (hubs); (3) Financial literacy training; (4) Access to credit/savings products; (5) Health services (clinics, insurance); (6) Legal support (accidents, disputes); (7) Community building (driver forums).
questions.evidence_required: Support center locations, Service usage stats, Driver satisfaction surveys
questions.africa_specific_notes: Drivers need holistic support beyond the app. Financial literacy helps with earnings management. Community reduces isolation.

scoring_notes: Layer 4 (Competence) for Transport in SSA: Driver training (safety, customer service) is the foundation of quality. Local route knowledge compensates for poor GPS/maps. Support in local languages is essential.
